title: no_daemon_required.sh's inside-the-project guard is an unbounded prefix, so it refuses a scratch directory beside the tree
body:
Found on 2026-11-12, in a read of Intent's tests that devbin-vc asked for through vc. Since devbin 0334, a remote leg runs its gates with TMPDIR at `<worktree>.tmp`, beside the worktree. devbin's own guard at `harness.bats:198`, an unbounded `"$DEVBIN_HOME"*)`, read that directory as inside the checkout, and the kovacs leg went red. Nothing that Intent's `gate all`, `build all` or `test shell` runs carries such a guard. One parity instrument does: `intent/st/ST0057/parity/tools/no_daemon_required.sh`, which no test or gate runs (`runner_roster_check.sh` lists it as manual, for ST0057 AT-07.5).

Its arm A makes a scratch project with `mktemp -d`, then refuses to go on when that directory resolves inside the project: `case "$(cd "$work" && pwd -P)" in "$REPO_ROOT"*) die ...`. The pattern has no `/` boundary, so a scratch directory under a TMPDIR whose path begins with the tree's own path, such as a leg's `<worktree>.tmp`, is refused as inside the project. The guard also compares a path read with `pwd -P` against a `REPO_ROOT` read with plain `pwd`, so in a tree reached through a symbolic link a scratch directory inside it is not refused.

The fix, on vc's ruling of 2026-11-12: `REPO_ROOT` is read with `pwd -P`, as the scratch path is, and the guard matches the root itself or a path below it, `"$REPO_ROOT" | "$REPO_ROOT"/*)`. Canon's copy of the attachment, in `intent/.canon/st/ST0057.json`, moves with it. The proof drives the guard's own case statement: a directory in `<root>.tmp` is refused at the base and passes after the fix, and a directory inside the root is still refused. The instrument cannot show it end to end while an intentd runs, because arm A refuses a live daemon before it reaches the guard. It is a parity tool, so the fix takes no CHANGELOG entry.


## Resolution

Fixed for the release after 3.3.0, in the commit that carries this resolution, banked as `refs/bank/dc/0688/fix-proven-on-594422fb4` and landed by vc. `REPO_ROOT` is read with `pwd -P`, as the scratch path is, and arm A's guard matches the root itself or a path below it, `"$REPO_ROOT" | "$REPO_ROOT"/*)`. `intent sync --to-store ST0057` carried the edit into canon's copy in `intent/.canon/st/ST0057.json`, whose text is the file byte for byte, and no other field of that record moved.

Proved on gyges on 2026-11-12, in a clone of rhadamanth's main at 594422fb4 carried there as a git bundle. A driver, kept at `refs/bank/dc/0688/drive-0688-guard.sh`, ran the file's own `REPO_ROOT` line and its own guard, as each revision carries them, against four directories. At 594422fb4, the code as it was, a directory in `<root>.tmp` was refused and a directory inside a root reached through a symbolic link passed, while a directory inside the root and the root itself were refused (10:16:36Z by gyges's `date -u`). With the fix, the `<root>.tmp` directory passes and the other three are refused (10:16:50Z). The instrument cannot show this end to end while an intentd runs, since arm A refuses a live daemon before it reaches the guard. The fix's patch on 594422fb4 is the same blob as the one banked on 923c4c44f, `3cf8dc12f`. No CHANGELOG entry: it is a parity tool.
